course.name: Simple Present

questions.questionSpeech: She, blank, tennis after school. Choose the correct verb: play or plays?

questions.explanation: Use the base verb with I, you, we, and they.

questions.questionSpeech: Match each English daily routine to its Indonesian meaning.
He, blank, his teeth before bed. Choose brush or brushes.
questions.answerSpeech: He brushes his teeth before bed.
questions.explanation: Add e-s to verbs that end in sh, ch, s, x, or o.

questions.answerSpeech: My parents drink coffee in the morning.
